Hero.title: La Travesía Campiña
Hero.subtitle: Restaurant, farm and lodging 35 minutes from Cuenca. Take a break on your journey.

RestaurantIntro.title: Country cooking, made with love
RestaurantIntro.description: Roasted cuy, free-range hen broth, potato locro… and gourmet dishes too. We raise and harvest the essentials on our own farm, so every bite tastes of the countryside.

GranjaTeaser.title: A family farm full of life, right next to the restaurant.

HospedajeTeaser.title: Stay the night and wake up to views of the Andes.

ContactSection.title: Get in Touch
ContactSection.subtitle: Message us on WhatsApp to book a table or a room. And if you're just passing by, come on in! There's always a spot for you.
ContactSection.formNote: WhatsApp will open with your message ready to send. We'll reply as soon as we can.

tradicion.title: Rooted here
tradicion.text: Our family has worked this land for generations. Long before the restaurant opened, we were already planting, raising animals and harvesting in Quingeo. That way of living the countryside is what we share with you in every dish.

sistema.title: Natural farming
sistema.text: We farm the way it has always been done in the countryside: with organic compost made right here, no chemicals, and following the rhythm of each season. Well-cared-for land gives its best, and you can taste it in every dish.

manejo.title: Well-cared-for animals
manejo.text: Our guinea pigs, hens, pigs, llamas and other animals live with plenty of space, fresh air and natural food. We look after them calmly and with care every day, and we love introducing them to our visitors.

Hospedaje.title: Lodging
Hospedaje.subtitle: Stay the night in Quingeo
Hospedaje.description: Cozy rooms with private bathroom, breakfast included and a view of the Andes you won't forget. Here the city noise stays far away and you truly rest.
Hospedaje.roomsDesc: Spacious, comfortable and facing the mountains or the garden. Made for resting like at home.
Hospedaje.roomDoubleDesc: Ideal for couples. Double bed, private bathroom and garden view.
Hospedaje.roomTripleDesc: Perfect for families: plenty of space and every comfort.
Hospedaje.roomSuiteDesc: Our most special room: private terrace, fireplace and panoramic views of the Andes.
Hospedaje.bookingText: Message us on WhatsApp and we'll confirm availability right away. Easy, no paperwork.
